name: fs_save
doc: One save backing (account save, device save, a cache storage, temporary storage) and its transaction. nxnative encodes this in which fields of a mount are set (commit, txn_root, ro) plus an atomic poison flag (dm/host/hle_fs.c); here it is one state. Recovering reads the container: at mount, after a refused commit (the working copy is discarded and rebuilt from the committed version) and when the outcome of a commit is not known. Clean: the working copy is the committed version. Dirty: it differs. Committing: the new manifest is written and the first barrier is awaited; nothing committed has changed yet. Sealing: the superblock slot is written (the one atomic step) and the second barrier is awaited. Poisoned: a storage write failed in this transaction; the next commit is refused. ReadOnly: the container could not be opened or read; every write fails, commits are no-ops.

Poisoned.name: err
Poisoned.type: errno of the first failed write of the transaction (28 no space, 5 I/O)
